hooks.command: HUB=/Users/kyusikkim/projects/playbook; SYNC=~/.claude/.blog-autopilot-hub-sync; CUR=$(cd $HUB 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null); LAST=$(cat $SYNC 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$CUR" ] && [ "$CUR" != "$LAST" ]; then if [ -n "$LAST" ]; then N=$(cd $HUB && git log --oneline $LAST..HEAD 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo "🔔 허브 갱신 ${N}건 (${LAST:0:7} → ${CUR:0:7}) — 새 정책/메모리 적용됨"; else echo "🔔 허브 sync init (${CUR:0:7})"; fi; echo $CUR > $SYNC; fi
